title: WIREPRESENCE-1 46c live ingress check: one claude-sonnet-5 (messages wire) turn through the post-46c response DTO + stream accumulator. The 46c ingress change is parse-strictly-lenient (12 fields newly carry Missing/Null/Value; container/stop_details newly parsed; stop_details terminal replacement; usage overlays retain/replace by carrier state) — the live risk is BEHAVIORAL (accumulator projections on a real stream), not parse failure. Tolerant verdict (SDD 46c §7 / RT-CW2 discipline): PASS = the turn completes (no acp_error) AND the turn's wire capture shows message_start + message_delta + message_stop + usage. Any deviation is a FINDING recorded in the report (non-blocking; blocking only if the turn died).

ndjson.label: TURN COMPLETES: the messages-wire turn did not die through the post-46c response ingress.

wire.label: STREAM SHAPE: the real claude stream carried a message_start (the carrier start event whose usage/container/stop_details the 46c DTO now parses three-state).
STREAM SHAPE: the real claude stream carried a message_delta (the terminal delta whose stop_details whole-state replacement and usage overlays 46c changed).
STREAM SHAPE: the stream terminated with message_stop (completed, not truncated).

USAGE FLOW: the stream carried usage objects (the fields 46c re-carried — input/output/cache buckets + details — flowed through the changed accumulator). Bare 'usage' substring: the wiretap embeds each SSE frame escaped inside a frame record ("usage": in-file), so the exact-key form can never match the capture format.

RT-46C1 VERDICT RECORD: newest-captured wire response status line, verbatim (machine-readable; recon reads the newest file by mtime). Disclosure: a parallel side call (grok-4.6 /v1/responses) may complete after the turn and therefore land newest — the turn response is the /v1/messages capture with message_start/message_stop frames. recon op — always records, never fails.
